title: Provenance envelope
description: How one recorded value came to be asserted. Embedded in the record it describes; the host record is the subject. Rust (crates/neuralcompose-mobile-core/src/provenance.rs) is authoritative for semantics — this schema is the description, the golden fixtures are the contract.

assertionKind.description: Five of these are spelled as neural-memory-server's EvidenceClass serializes them. heuristicAnnotation has no counterpart there, deliberately.

method.description: null only for kinds that do not require a method. Never omitted.

confidence.description: null means unscored. Never promotes a kind.

comparisonEmbeddingSpace.description: The single embedding space every compared vector came from. null means this assertion rests on no embedding comparison — it is NOT a wildcard, and two nulls never match.

allOf.$comment: A derivation that named no inputs cannot be recomputed, and an unrecomputable derivation is just an assertion.
Kinds that must name the software and frozen parameters that produced them.
An observation is measured, a derivation is recomputed, a human decision is a decision. None of the three is scored.

resourceKind.$comment: A free label, not an enum: a new kind of resource must not require a core release (ADR-002 decision 1).

locator.description: Where inside the resource. null means the whole of it.

gitCommit.description: The full 40-character object name. null means this build did not come from a git checkout — never treated as pinned. An abbreviated commit is ambiguous and is rejected.

parametersDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical parameter document. Not nullable: an empty parameter set still has a digest.
